summary.text: Bobby Levy is a Republican state representative from Oregon House District 58 in eastern Oregon who has served since January 11, 2021, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A farmer and rancher, she lives in Echo.

paragraphs.text: Bobby Levy was born in La Grande, Oregon, and lives in Echo.
She earned an M.B.A. from Portland State University and a master's degree in teacher education from Eastern Oregon University.
Her career experience includes working as a college adjunct professor, insurance agent, farmer and rancher, and policy advocate, and she co-founded the Eastern Oregon Women's Coalition.
Levy succeeded Greg Barreto in the Oregon House.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she said she is running for a fourth term and listed among her work investments for communities, wildfire funding, wolf depredation, rural infrastructure, and a voice for agriculture and natural resource industries in state policy.
